remediation.invariant: A pending claim cannot certify a formal gate or permit another provider launch; the approved reasoned-bypass policy may independently admit formal entry.
remediation.approach: Clarify claim reconciliation before another launch separately from approved formal reasoned admission. Exercise pending admission, retained claim, once-only provider launch, and all formal gates remaining unset.

regressions.scenario: Pending advisory claim remains single-run and noncertifying when formal entry has a retained reason.

remediation.invariant: Every valid recorded formal FAIL must remain code-failure checklist work without requiring a different historical formal contract.
remediation.approach: Normalize failed rubric/independent-check rows when separate concerns are absent. Preserve bound report/receipt, use reported paths or marked complete-scope reconciliation areas, require class coverage and passing regressions, and retain full-scope advisory review.

regressions.scenario: Criterion-only FAIL, FAIL without exact paths and independent-scope-only FAIL all enter the complete fix checklist and require defect-class review.

priorFindings.summary: Proceed can admit formal entry while advisory execution is still IN_PROGRESS.
priorFindings.invariant: A retained proceed reason may bypass only a completed non-clean advisory disposition such as FINDINGS or UNAVAILABLE after the retry/error contract, not an unreconciled execution claim.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:775 records proceed reasons after only finding readiness.json; it does not require a review result or unavailable disposition.
plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:889 treats missing review.json as IN_PROGRESS, and lines 893-895 accept any non-clean outcome when proceed.json exists.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory.js:916 can bind proof.review to claim.json, while plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory-contract.js:544-550 explicitly permits IN_PROGRESS with proceed evidence.

priorFindings.summary: Formal Judge FAIL records can be accepted without structured findings, then cannot enter the advisory checklist.
priorFindings.invariant: Every recorded formal code failure that drives revised readiness must expose structured supported findings with invariant and affected paths so advisory reruns can bind and check them exactly once.
evidence: plugin-src/shared/resources/agent-workflows/judge/result.schema.json:55 defines findings as an array without minItems or any requirement tied to FAIL results.
plugin-src/shared/resources/agent-workflows/judge/validator.js:21-24 derives FAIL solely from criteria/scope/gap/contradiction results and does not require concern findings for a FAIL verdict.

plugin-src/shared/resources/protocol/advisory-history.js:110-113 later requires at least one severity concern finding before building prior formal advisory findings, so an accepted formal FAIL with empty findings cannot become the required checklist/remediation input.
